factory.name: Factory
factory.description: Base industry plus better output from every industrial worker.

mine.name: Mining complex
mine.description: Base resource extraction and miner bonuses scale with mineral richness.

trade_center.name: Trade centre
trade_center.description: Base credits plus income from every population unit.

research_lab.name: Research lab
research_lab.description: Base research plus better output from every scientist.

hydroponic_farm.name: Hydroponic farm
hydroponic_farm.description: Base food plus better output from every farmer.

barracks.name: Barracks
barracks.description: Trains a local garrison and enables troop transport construction. One per colony.

fortifications.name: Fortifications
fortifications.description: Bunkers give all defending troops 50% more firepower. One per colony.

missile_base.name: Missile base
missile_base.description: A planetary surface battery defending orbit with 40 hull, range 8 and 10 missile damage. One per colony.

planetary_shield.name: Planetary shield
planetary_shield.description: Blocks hostile landings while charged. Regenerates 25 points each peaceful turn. Barrier Fields improves capacity and upkeep.

sensor_array.name: Sensor array
sensor_array.description: Extends this system's researched detection radius by 5 ly. Multiple arrays in one system do not stack.

jump_gate.name: Jump gate
jump_gate.description: Connect two of your colonies for +50% travel speed on new orders. Replaces the navigation network bonus.

interdictor.name: Interdiction generator
interdictor.description: Slows hostile approaches within 5 ly by 25%. Subspace Interdiction improves the radius and strength.

solar_array.name: Solar array
solar_array.description: Generates local power without fuel or assigned workers.

fusion_plant.name: Fusion plant
fusion_plant.description: A compact reactor supplies substantial local power. No fuel resource required.

geothermal_plant.name: Geothermal plant
geothermal_plant.description: Deep thermal wells provide steady local power without consuming Resources.

thermal_plant.name: Thermal backup plant
thermal_plant.description: Burns Resources only when other generators cannot cover working buildings. Last to run; 1 Resource per 4 energy, rounded up per plant.

singularity_plant.name: Singularity plant
singularity_plant.description: A stabilized micro-singularity provides high continuous power without consuming Resources.

torpedo.name: Torpedo launcher
torpedo.description: 10 damage · range 8 · countered by point defense

siege.name: Siege cannon
siege.description: 8 damage · range 6 · triple damage to bases and planetary shields

shield.name: Shield generator
shield.description: +12 shields · restored at the start of each battle

engine.name: Maneuvering thruster
engine.description: +1 tactical movement · does not change travel speed

scanner.name: Combat scanner
scanner.description: +1 weapon range · one scanner per ship

ion.name: Ion cannon
ion.description: 8 hull / up to 32 shield damage · range 6

graviton.name: Graviton beam
graviton.description: 16 damage · range 6 · slow target 1 cell (no stacking)

disruptor.name: Disruptor
disruptor.description: 40 damage · range 5 · recharge 1 turn after firing

fusion_torpedo.name: Fusion launcher
fusion_torpedo.description: 18 damage · range 9 · intercepted by point defense

mirv.name: MIRV launcher
mirv.description: 3 × 7 damage · range 8 · ignores half of interception

antimatter.name: Antimatter launcher
antimatter.description: 36 damage · range 9 · reload 1 turn after firing

regenerative_shield.name: Regenerative shield
regenerative_shield.description: +8 shields · recover 2 at the start of each turn

damage_control.name: Damage control
damage_control.description: Repair 3 hull/turn · reserve 12/battle · battle damage only

interceptor_bay.name: Interceptor bay
interceptor_bay.description: Carrier · 2 active / 4 launches · protect allies within 2 cells

bomber_bay.name: Bomber bay
bomber_bay.description: Carrier · 2 active / 4 launches · double damage to capitals

terran.name: Terrans
terran.description: Human explorers whose diverse societies value negotiation, exchange and new frontiers.

kharuun.name: Kharuun
kharuun.description: Mineral-bodied engineers who measure trust through reliable exchange and lasting works.

aelari.name: Aelari
aelari.description: Ocean-born archivists who build alliances around shared discovery and patient inquiry.

lithar.name: Lithar
lithar.description: Ancient stone organisms that endure hostile worlds and measure their future in geological ages.
abilities: Settle every biome; double population limits.
Half food consumption, rounded up.
Population grows at one quarter of the usual rate.

varkesh.name: Varkesh
varkesh.description: Armored warlords rule through fear, plunder rival worlds and drag captives back to a single fortified stronghold.
abilities: Cannot colonize; ship speed and range +50%.
Raids steal credits and slaves; home limit 100.
Slaves: normal output, 5% mortality each turn.
Ships −20% resource cost; native capacity +50%; research −20%.

wanderers.name: Wanderers
wanderers.description: Travel-worn navigators whose shipbuilding traditions and long-range fleets keep distant horizons within reach.
abilities: Ships reach 3 light-years farther from colonies.
All ships cost 15% fewer resources.
Colony industry output is 15% lower.

xenonflora.name: Xenonflora
xenonflora.description: Interwoven plant minds that flourish on living worlds, growing cities as extensions of their own bodies.
abilities: Terran, Ocean and Gaia colonies produce +3 food.
Population grows 50% faster on those worlds.
Industry is 25% lower on all other biomes.

nexus.name: Nexus
nexus.description: Linked machine minds that assemble new citizens in industrial foundries and work without organic sustenance.
abilities: Settle every biome; no food required.
Gross industry output is 25% higher.
20% of industry assembles population until full.

aetheri.name: Aetheri
aetheri.description: Patient currents of sentient energy whose insight outpaces their ability to shape solid matter.
abilities: Settle every biome; no food required.
Population grows by 10% of a billion per turn.
Colony research +25%; colony industry -20%.

concord.name: The Concord
concord.description: Countless minds bound to one will. The collective seeks to absorb independent civilizations, their worlds and their knowledge.
abilities: Networked pacts: +3 CR trade; +1 RP research.
Colony credit income is 10% lower.
Conquest brings populations into the collective.

remnant.name: The Remnant
remnant.description: Proud, patient survivors of a magnificent civilization, carrying fragments of knowledge and a quiet sense of loss.
abilities: Begin with 80 research points to spend.
Research +25%; industry −20%.
Awakened tomb worlds join your empire.

prefabricated_structures.name: Prefabricated Structures
prefabricated_structures.description: New building orders cost 20% fewer resources.

orbital_assembly.name: Orbital Assembly
orbital_assembly.description: New ship orders cost 20% fewer resources.

ion_drives.name: Ion Drives
ion_drives.description: +25% ship speed on newly ordered voyages. Unlock maneuvering thrusters in the ship designer.

compact_reactors.name: Compact Reactors
compact_reactors.description: +1 industry, +1 credit and +4 energy per colony.

fusion_drives.name: Fusion Drives
fusion_drives.description: +50% ship speed on newly ordered voyages.

fusion_grids.name: Fusion Grids
fusion_grids.description: +2 industry per factory and +8 energy per colony. Unlock thermal backup plants: up to 24 energy; burn Resources only when needed.

quantum_optics.name: Quantum Optics
quantum_optics.description: +3 research per laboratory. Standard frigates and carriers gain 7-damage beams. Unlock 14-damage quantum batteries for new designs.

radiation_shields.name: Radiation Shields
radiation_shields.description: Colony ships can settle barren worlds. Unlock ship shield generators (+12 shields per module).

habitat_shields.name: Habitat Shields
habitat_shields.description: +2 credits per desert or tundra colony.

thermal_barriers.name: Thermal Barriers
thermal_barriers.description: Colony ships can settle volcanic worlds.

industrial_force_fields.name: Industrial Force Fields
industrial_force_fields.description: +2 resources per operational mine, regardless of mineral richness.

deep_core_drills.name: Deep Core Drills
deep_core_drills.description: +2 resources per operational mine, regardless of richness. Unlock geothermal plants: +20 energy, 2 CR/turn upkeep.

lightweight_alloys.name: Lightweight Alloys
lightweight_alloys.description: Lighter fuel tanks: +10 ly range. New ships cost 10% fewer resources.

superconductors.name: Superconductors
superconductors.description: +1 industry per colony and +2 research per laboratory.

composite_structures.name: Composite Structures
composite_structures.description: Advanced fuel tanks: +15 ly range. New buildings cost 15% fewer resources.

colony_biospheres.name: Colony Biospheres
colony_biospheres.description: New colonies start with 1 billion additional inhabitants.

colony_biogenesis.name: Colony Biogenesis
colony_biogenesis.description: New colonies start with 2 billion additional inhabitants.

ecology_networks.name: Ecology Networks
ecology_networks.description: +1 credit per 2 billion inhabitants on each colony.

research_networks.name: Research Networks
research_networks.description: +1 research per colony and per laboratory. Unlock combat scanners (+1 weapon range).

planetary_automation.name: Planetary Automation
planetary_automation.description: +1 industry per factory and +1 resource per operational mine.

cultural_exchange.name: Cultural Exchange
cultural_exchange.description: Your active trade pact earns +3 credits; your research pact earns +3 research.

ascension_theory.name: Ascension Theory
ascension_theory.description: Unlock the Ascension Gate and a scientific victory.

advanced_fortifications.name: Advanced Fortifications
advanced_fortifications.description: Fortifications gain +25 percentage points of defending firepower.

fusion_power.name: Fusion Power
fusion_power.description: Unlock fusion plants: +30 local energy per plant, with 3 CR/turn upkeep.

colonial_navigation.name: Colonial Navigation Network
colonial_navigation.description: +25% travel speed between your own colonized systems.

jump_gates.name: Jump Gates
jump_gates.description: Unlock jump gates. Gates at both endpoints give +50% internal travel speed, replacing any navigation bonus.

field_stabilization.name: Field Stabilization
field_stabilization.description: Halve hostile interdiction slowdown. Unlock singularity plants: +50 energy with 5 CR/turn upkeep and no Resource fuel.

orbital_defense_systems.name: Orbital Defense Systems
orbital_defense_systems.description: Unlock missile bases: immobile defenders in fleet battles, with 40 hull and 10-damage missiles.

precision_beam_optics.name: Precision Beam Optics
precision_beam_optics.description: Halve the accuracy penalty for firing beam weapons at long range.

siege_weapons.name: Siege Weapons
siege_weapons.description: Unlock siege cannons: triple damage to planetary shields and missile bases. Standard warships gain double bombardment damage.

torpedo_guidance.name: Advanced Torpedo Guidance
torpedo_guidance.description: Halve target evasion against torpedoes and missiles. Point defense still intercepts successful hits.

planetary_shielding.name: Planetary Shielding
planetary_shielding.description: Unlock 100-point planetary shield generators. Suppress the shield before landing troops.

gravity_wells.name: Gravity-Well Generators
gravity_wells.description: Unlock interdiction generators: hostile final approaches slow by 25% within 5 ly.

barrier_fields.name: Barrier Fields
barrier_fields.description: Unlock or upgrade planetary generators to 200 shield points, with 6 CR/turn upkeep.

subspace_interdiction.name: Subspace Interdiction
subspace_interdiction.description: Unlock or upgrade interdiction generators: 40% slowdown within 8 ly, with 5 CR/turn upkeep.

electronic_countermeasures.name: Electronic Countermeasures
electronic_countermeasures.description: Your ships gain 10 percentage points of evasion.

deep_space_radar.name: Deep-Space Radar
deep_space_radar.description: Detect fleet positions and owners within 5 ly of colonies. Unlock sensor arrays (+5 ly locally).

targeting_computers.name: Targeting Computers
targeting_computers.description: +10 percentage points to weapon hit chance from targeting computers.

long_range_sensors.name: Long-Range Sensors
long_range_sensors.description: Detect fleets within 10 ly and reveal ship counts. Unlock sensor arrays. Replaces earlier sensor range.

predictive_fire_control.name: Predictive Fire Control
predictive_fire_control.description: +20 percentage points to weapon hit chance from targeting computers. Replaces earlier targeting bonuses.

subspace_scanners.name: Subspace Scanners
subspace_scanners.description: Detect fleets within 20 ly; reveal classes and movement direction. Unlock sensor arrays. Replaces earlier sensor range.

quantum_targeting.name: Quantum Targeting
quantum_targeting.description: +30 percentage points to weapon hit chance from targeting computers. Replaces earlier targeting bonuses.

gravitic_mapping.name: Gravitic Mapping
gravitic_mapping.description: Reveal the names and locations of black holes. Approaching them remains fatal without Event Horizon Navigation.

event_horizon_navigation.name: Event Horizon Navigation
event_horizon_navigation.description: Reveal black holes and safely approach their ancient relic sites. A legendary guardian must be defeated to recover each relic. Includes Gravitic Mapping.

destroyer_hulls.name: Destroyer Hulls
destroyer_hulls.description: Unlock destroyers: agile torpedo warships. Build the standard class or create a custom design.

modular_spaceframes.name: Modular Spaceframes
modular_spaceframes.description: New ships cost 10% fewer Resources. Does not unlock destroyers.

cruiser_hulls.name: Cruiser Hulls
cruiser_hulls.description: Unlock cruisers: versatile warships with eight module spaces. Does not unlock skipped hull classes.

deep_space_logistics.name: Deep-Space Logistics
deep_space_logistics.description: +5 ly fuel range for your fleets. Does not unlock cruisers.

battleship_hulls.name: Battleship Hulls
battleship_hulls.description: Unlock battleships: heavy gun platforms with twelve module spaces. Drone carriers are the alternative choice.

drone_carriers.name: Drone Carriers
drone_carriers.description: Unlock carrier hulls and drone bays. Each bay supports two active drones and four launches per battle. Battleships are the alternative choice.

titan_hulls.name: Titan Hulls
titan_hulls.description: Unlock titans: massive capital ships with eighteen module spaces. Does not unlock skipped hull classes.

mass_ship_production.name: Mass Ship Production
mass_ship_production.description: New ships cost 20% fewer Resources. Does not unlock titans.

pulse_beams.name: Pulse Beams
pulse_beams.description: Unlock pulse cannons: two accurate 4-damage shots, range 6. Compact weapons for fighting small ships and drones.

plasma_beams.name: Plasma Beams
plasma_beams.description: Unlock plasma cannons: 24 damage, range 4. High close-range damage in two weapon spaces.

ion_beams.name: Ion Beams
ion_beams.description: Unlock ion cannons: 8 hull damage or up to 32 shield damage, range 6. Extra shield damage does not spill into hull damage.

graviton_beams.name: Graviton Beams
graviton_beams.description: Unlock graviton beams: 16 damage, range 6. A hit slows the target by one cell through its next turn; does not stack or reduce movement below one.

particle_beams.name: Particle Beams
particle_beams.description: Unlock particle lances: 20 damage, range 10, using three weapon spaces. Long-range fleet artillery.

heavy_beam_mounts.name: Heavy Beam Mounts
heavy_beam_mounts.description: Unlock heavy beam batteries: 30 damage, range 9, using four weapon spaces. Large mounts for capital ships.

phased_beams.name: Phased Beams
phased_beams.description: Unlock phased beams: 16 damage, range 7. Half the damage bypasses ship shields. Hardened shields reduce this penetration.

disruptor_beams.name: Disruptor Beams
disruptor_beams.description: Unlock disruptors: 40 damage, range 5, using three weapon spaces. Must recharge for one full combat turn after firing.

fusion_torpedoes.name: Fusion Torpedoes
fusion_torpedoes.description: Unlock fusion launchers: 18 damage, range 9. Benefits from torpedo guidance; vulnerable to point defense.

reinforced_armor.name: Reinforced Armor
reinforced_armor.description: Unlock reinforced armor plates: +14 hull in one defense space, with -1 tactical movement (minimum one).

mirv_torpedoes.name: MIRV Torpedoes
mirv_torpedoes.description: Unlock MIRV launchers: three 7-damage warheads, range 8. Each rolls separately and ignores half of enemy interception.

antimatter_torpedoes.name: Antimatter Torpedoes
antimatter_torpedoes.description: Unlock antimatter launchers: 36 damage, range 9. Must reload for one full combat turn; vulnerable to point defense.

regenerative_shields.name: Regenerative Shields
regenerative_shields.description: Unlock regenerating shield modules: +8 capacity, restoring 2 shield points at the start of each ship's turn. Less capacity than ordinary shields.

hardened_shields.name: Hardened Shields
hardened_shields.description: Unlock hardened shield modules: +12 capacity. While shields remain, reduce phased penetration by 75%. Hardening does not stack.

interceptor_drones.name: Interceptor Drones
interceptor_drones.description: Unlock interceptor bays for carriers: fast drones deal 8 damage to drones, 2 to other targets. Each nearby interceptor adds 20% fleet interception within two cells (maximum 40%). Requires a carrier hull.

advanced_flak.name: Advanced Flak Systems
advanced_flak.description: Unlock flak modules: 45% interception per module against torpedoes and drones, with a 75% shipboard cap. Fits any combat hull.

bomber_drones.name: Bomber Drones
bomber_drones.description: Unlock bomber bays for carriers: slower drones deal 5 damage, doubled against cruisers, larger ships, bases and guardians. Vulnerable to interception. Requires a carrier hull.

automated_damage_control.name: Automated Damage Control
automated_damage_control.description: Unlock repair systems for any combat hull. Each repairs up to 3 hull at the start of a turn, with 12 hull of reserve per battle. Repairs only damage suffered in that battle.

cryogenic_fuel_tanks.name: Cryogenic Fuel Tanks
cryogenic_fuel_tanks.description: +10 ly fleet range from every owned colony. Automatically upgrades all ships; stacks with other tank research. Does not change travel speed.

automated_refineries.name: Automated Refineries
automated_refineries.description: +3 Resources per operational mining complex, regardless of mineral richness.

antimatter_fuel_tanks.name: Antimatter Fuel Tanks
antimatter_fuel_tanks.description: +15 ly fleet range from every owned colony. Automatically upgrades all ships; stacks with other tank research. Does not require Cryogenic Fuel Tanks.

molecular_shipbuilding.name: Molecular Shipbuilding
molecular_shipbuilding.description: New ship orders cost 15% fewer Resources. Already placed orders keep their price.

spatial_compression_tanks.name: Spatial-Compression Tanks
spatial_compression_tanks.description: +20 ly fleet range from every owned colony. Automatically upgrades all ships; stacks with other tank research. Does not require earlier tank choices.

nanostructured_materials.name: Nanostructured Materials
nanostructured_materials.description: +4 industry per colony, without additional workers or power consumption.

construction.name: Construction
construction.description: Build productive colonies and efficient shipyards.

power.name: Power & Propulsion
power.description: Choose faster voyages or stronger planetary power grids.

physics.name: Physics
physics.description: Advance research instruments and beam weapons.

fields.name: Force Fields
fields.description: Protect settlements and work in hostile environments.

materials.name: Materials & Chemistry
materials.description: Improve extraction, fuel tanks and construction materials.

biology.name: Biology
biology.description: Support larger expeditions and more prosperous colonies.

computers.name: Computers
computers.description: Connect laboratories, automate industry and optimize trade.

starships.name: Starship Engineering
starships.description: Research new hull classes or specialize fleet production and range.

terran.summary: Welcome exchange and new frontiers. Rebuild trust readily, but may challenge a weaker, unfriendly neighbour.
terran.greeting: We crossed the dark wondering who we would find. May this meeting open a better future for both our peoples.

kharuun.summary: Value reliable exchange and lasting agreements. Trust grows through deeds; broken promises are slow to heal.
kharuun.greeting: Fine words are easily shaped. Let us see whether your promises endure.

aelari.summary: Seek shared discoveries and research partners. Prefer peaceful development and defend their own worlds.
aelari.greeting: A new voice in the cosmos. What might we learn from one another?

lithar.summary: Build strong defences and seldom begin wars. Their worlds are enduring commitments, and their grudges endure too.
lithar.greeting: We have endured the passing of suns. Tread gently upon our worlds, and we shall endure beside you.

varkesh.summary: Strike at weak colonies for slaves and plunder. Respect strength; active agreements stay their raiding fleets.
varkesh.greeting: We are the Varkesh. Your wealth will fill our vaults. Your people will fill our slave holds. Resist, and your worlds will burn.

wanderers.summary: Welcome travellers and trade. Prefer exploration and quick reconciliation to prolonged territorial wars.
wanderers.greeting: Another light along the road. May our paths cross in friendship, and our horizons remain open.

xenonflora.summary: Guard their living communities with shields and fortifications. Trust grows slowly after harm or betrayal.
xenonflora.greeting: We hear your voice beyond the roots. Do you come to nurture, or to consume?

nexus.summary: Evaluate exchange through practical benefit. May expand by force against an unfriendly neighbour when the odds favour success.
nexus.greeting: Independent intelligence confirmed. Mutually beneficial exchange is possible. State your priorities.

aetheri.summary: Value patient dialogue and knowledge over material gifts. Avoid conquest and invest in protective fields.
aetheri.greeting: Another voice reaches us across the silence. We are listening.

concord.summary: One will seeks to absorb every independent civilization. Build invasion fleets early; agreements postpone assimilation.
concord.greeting: We are the Concord. Your separation is temporary. Your knowledge, your worlds, your voices will become ours.

remnant.summary: Guard lost knowledge and ancient claims. Slow to forgive, and willing to confront a weaker, unfriendly neighbour.
remnant.greeting: You name these stars as though they have never belonged to anyone. We remember otherwise.
